name: wardle/hades
what_it_is: A lightweight HL7 FHIR R4 terminology server written in Clojure that wraps the hermes SNOMED CT library, exposing SNOMED CT via standard FHIR terminology REST operations. Read-only by design.
components: Jetty HTTP server with FHIR routes
HAPI FHIR library for data model
configuration: hermes version must match hades version series
constraints: SNOMED CT database must be pre-built with hermes before starting
hermes version must match hades version
Only SNOMED CT supported; other codesystems are roadmap
XML support depends on HAPI FHIR library
notable_absences: No LOINC, ICD-10, or other codesystems
